description: List or search published books. Omit q to browse all records. Returns the public REST representation, pagination totals and next/previous REST links; increment page to continue. Books include categories, publisher-maintained overall availability (unknown is not unavailable), and structured purchase_destinations ordered with verified Amazon.com links first. This ordering does not change book recommendation/catalog ranking. No live retailer stock is provided. Includes publication-filtered relationships and public links. Use get_book for a known ID. Large pages may require a smaller per_page; content is never silently truncated.

author_id.description: Filter by a public catalog author ID.

category.description: Exact publisher category slug from list_book_categories or GET /api/v1/book-categories. Combines with q, sorting, author and pagination; omit for all categories.

q.description: Optional text search; omit to list the entire published collection. Articles search title, subtitle, excerpt and byline, not full body.

sort.description: Catalog ordering, ascending ID, or descending ID.

name: search_books
